ABOUT BUFFS

Our Story

Who We Are

Buffs Chicken started in Malolos, Bulacan with one goal—to serve juicy, flavorful chicken that's worth every peso. After moving to Angeles City in March 2025, Buffs has found its perfect home among food-loving students and young professionals.

We're more than just a chicken spot. We're a community gathering place where great food meets great people, and every meal is an experience worth sharing.

Our Mission

To deliver high-quality, flavor-packed meals that bring people together—whether at The Hood, during pop-ups, or from the comfort of your own home.
